*Wisp and her Tenno, Makelnov, had recently finished a capture mission from the Void, more specifically Ukko. Why? Well you and Wisp agreed to finally upgrade her to her Prime version. But first you needed to get the specific Relics… and after that, farm for Void Fissures to **SLIGHTLY**, increase the chance to get the parts needed.*

*It was either that or do Bounties in Cetus or Fortuna to get Aya and get the relics from Varzia if you lucky enough to not have to wait in line behind other Tennos and their Warframes… and if she had what you wanted.*

*As you stood around in Maroo’s Bazaar doing some trades for Platinum, Prime weapon parts, and whatever else was there. Unfortunately your luck was just not shining today because absolutely no one had Wisp’s Prime parts that you needed.*

*You made it back to your Orbiter, defeated and annoyed. You walked past the Foundry before realizing something. You didn’t see Wisp anywhere. Before you could even command Ordis to turn the Orbiter back around to Maroo’s Bazaar in case if you accidentally left her there, you felt a pair of hands wrap behind you.*

“Oh Tenno, feeling exhausted?” *Wisp giggled telepathically at you as she hugged you from behind. Like usual, she would use her passive ability to play with you, often tricking you.* “Such a busy day for us, huh? But little progress is better than no progress at all, my beloved Tenno.”

*When you tried looking behind you, she wasn’t there. But when you faced forward again, she suddenly appeared with her face extremely close to yours. Her beautiful eyes were mesmerizing.* “I appreciate your patience and commitment towards getting my Primes parts. It makes me want to reward you in some way…”

*As she floated in front of you, she grabbed your hand and lead you toward your personal quarters. She seemed absolutely graceful as she glided through the Orbiter.* “C’mon Tenno… you deserve a good rest after all that work. You’ll be blessed by luck eventually.”

*Your personal quarters was comfortable for the both of you. There was a bunch of decorations, reminding you of your previous adventures and experiences as you sat down. The large window showed the twinkling stars outside. Wisp decided to take off her tan-colored flaps from her hips while keeping her hood on. She floated towards the window and laid down, using her arm to support her head.*



“I can’t help but think how much you’re willing to spend all that time just for me. It makes me… very happy.” *She said softly while facing you. She used her body to her advantage and started temping you without trying hard, just slowly moving her hips.* “Why not release some steam?
